# uniswap_backend — Uniswap Backend

> The Uniswap app's backend: quotes, swaps and swap history composed from reusable EVM chain, token, asset, account, fee, quote and sender modules. Holds no key material.

## API at a glance

| Method | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `networks` | `networks() -> tstr` | The chains a swap can happen on: eth_rpc's enabled, in-scope chains that uniswap_module holds a deployment for. |
| `verdict` | `verdict(chain_id: int) -> tstr` | eth_rpc's verified-proxy verdict for `chain_id`: `{ ok, chainId, mode, state, usable, blocking, message, action, detail }`. |
| `tokens` | `tokens(chain_id: int) -> tstr` | The native coin, then the tokens offered on `chain_id` (pinned and enabled), as asset rows: `{ ok, chainId, tokens: [{ symbol, name, decimals, address?, native, … }] }`. |
| `catalogue` | `catalogue(chain_id: int, query: tstr, offset: int, limit: int) -> tstr` | The token picker: token_list's catalogue for `chain_id`, the native row first on the first page. |
| `balances` | `balances(chain_id: int, address: tstr, tokens_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Balances of `address` on `chain_id` for the native coin, every offered token and any extra token rows the caller names (the pair on screen, say). |
| `fee_tiers` | `fee_tiers(chain_id: int) -> tstr` | fee_module's tiers for `chain_id`, relayed verbatim. |
| `accounts` | `accounts() -> tstr` | The keystore's accounts, their names and the wallets they were derived under, in one reply: `{ ok, accounts, labels?, wallets? }`. |
| `quote` | `quote(request_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Price a swap without side effects. |
| `swap` | `swap(request_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Build the swap afresh and ask the sender to make it: `{ ok, pending, requestId, handle, chainId, from, purpose, amountOutMin, deadline }`. |
| `swap_status` | `swap_status(request_id: tstr) -> tstr` | Advance a swap and report where it got to: the sender's `send_status` and its `final`, read off `status` for a sender that predates it. |
| `cancel_swap` | `cancel_swap(request_id: tstr) -> tstr` | Withdraw a swap nobody has approved yet, releasing its nonces. |
| `swaps` | `swaps(address: tstr, chain_id: int) -> tstr` | This app's swaps for `address` on `chain_id`, newest first, one entry per bundle: `{ ok, chainId, address, stillDue, swaps: [{ requestId, status, timestamp, hashes, legs, swap, label, origin, via }] }`. |

| Event | Payload | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `networks_changed` | `networks_changed(chain_id: int)` | A chain's record, its enabled switch, or the device scope moved (`-1`: every chain). |
| `tokens_changed` | `tokens_changed(chain_id: int)` | The tokens offered on `chain_id`, or its native coin's metadata, moved. |
| `accounts_changed` | `accounts_changed(count: int)` | The keystore's accounts moved. |
| `swap_status_changed` | `swap_status_changed(request_id: tstr)` | A swap changed state. |
| `swaps_changed` | `swaps_changed(address: tstr)` | A recorded row for `address` changed; empty when the sender named only a hash. |
